items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn't know her at all.

ctx.x: I didn't know her at all. I went there with a trumpet player. It wasn't Joe Wallace,… He knew very well that I did not know her. She was a very fine pianist. She wrote some great tunes.
Were even if one of those famous sessions that she had with musicians?
